rationale: The Stats stage showed that 12 months of prospective data would give about 260 events, enough to fit but not to validate a model with the planned predictors, while published models fail mostly through too few events and no validation (c4). The main reason for prospective collection, poor charting of nausea (c2), is answered by the validated rescue antiemetic proxy (c5), recorded electronically since 2019. Existing records from 2019 to 2023 give about 2,600 procedures and about 1,100 overnight stays for development, and 2024 to 2025 give a temporal validation set. List position (c3) and surgeon clustering are handled explicitly, and the published predictors (c1) inform the candidate list. Mobilisation time is available only from mid-2021 and is used in a sensitivity analysis.
alternatives: Prospective cohort with a readiness assessment (withdrawn: too few events for development and validation before 2028, and nursing time is unfunded)
Adopt the published nine-predictor model (refused: not validated and built partly by significance testing)
whyNotMoreComplex: A prospective multi-year collection would delay recommendations and repeat what existing records can provide with a validated proxy.

decision.statement: Develop the booking-time model from the existing records of 2019 to 2023, with rescue antiemetic doses as the measure of nausea needing treatment and list position and surgeon handled explicitly, and validate it on the 2024 to 2025 records, replacing the prospective cohort.
decision.question: Which data should the booking-time prediction model be built on?

criteria.text: Existing records hold enough events to develop a penalised model with the planned predictors and validate it on a later period.
The rescue antiemetic proxy fails the local check against 100 sampled charts.

gates.requirement: Data access approval for electronic health record and theatre management data
gates.evidence: Data access committee approval DAC-2026-51 dated 2026-09-02, supplied by the investigator

gates.requirement: Analyst time for data management and modelling
gates.evidence: Decision support request DS-2026-88 for about 20 analyst days, supplied by the investigator

alternatives: Prospective cohort with a readiness assessment (withdrawn)
decision.note: Replaces the accepted prospective decision, which the investigator withdraws: the Stats stage showed that 12 months of prospective data would give too few events to develop and validate a model with the planned predictors (c4), while the validated antiemetic proxy (c5) removes the main reason for prospective collection.

summary: Retrospective development and temporal validation recommended; the earlier prospective decision is to be withdrawn by the investigator.
